sections.text: Connect with ancient tradition through the Gītā Wisdom and iChing Oracle. Each personalised draw offers deep insights from the Bhagavad Gītā As It Is (1972) and The Book of Changes (I Ching). Let this timeless guidance and millenium tradition enlighten your path today.Use it to build self-awareness and spiritual harmony. Use it to build self-awareness and spiritual harmony.

sections.list: Press ✦ Gītā Wisdom ✦ for a random verse OR: select a chapter + verse number and press Look up Inside the card: press 📖 Read Purport for commentary Navigate with ← → arrows, swipe, or keyboard arrow keys Keyboard: P toggle purport · G random Gita · Esc close

Press ✦ iChing ✦ or ☯ Toss Coins for a random hexagram Or enter a hexagram number (1–64) and press ☯ Toss Coins Inside the card: press 📖 Read Commentary for interpretation Navigate with ← → arrows, swipe, or keyboard arrow keys Keyboard: P toggle commentary · H random iChing · Esc close

footer:
